device_fingerprint.description: An obfuscated ID derived from the device ID.

ip_address.description: The IP address of the device at provisioning time.

location.description: The geographic latitude/longitude coordinates of the device at provisioning time. The format is [+-]decimal/[+-]decimal.

name.description: The name of the device used for tokenization.

phone_number.description: The phone number of the device used for tokenization.

type.description: The type of device used for tokenization.
